statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope accompanied by palpitations
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
Continuous rhythm correlation during daily activities was needed
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The diagnosis codes are R55 and I47.1
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
SilverBridge Advantage requires precertification or prior authorization for such diagnostic monitoring services
